exercises.name: Band biceps curl
exercises.cue: Band under one or both feet, palms out, elbows tucked, curl the fists to the shoulders and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band lateral raise
exercises.cue: Band under both feet, palms in, raise straight arms to shoulder height without shrugging.

exercises.name: Band lunge with shoulder press
exercises.cue: Band under the front foot; drop into a lunge while pressing the arms overhead, return and repeat.

exercises.name: Band shoulder press
exercises.cue: Band under both feet, fists at shoulder height, press overhead until the hands meet, widen the grip on the way down.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.cue: Bar on upper back, brace, sit between the hips, knees track over toes, drive up through mid-foot.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinned, bar to lower chest, elbows ~45°, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Clean (any style)
exercises.cue: Bar from the floor to the shoulders, squat or power, elbows through at the top.

exercises.name: Clean and jerk
exercises.cue: Pull the bar to the shoulders, stand, then dip and drive it overhead to lockout. Power clean and push jerk is fine.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.cue: Hands just inside shoulder width, elbows tucked, bar to the lower chest, press to lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned at the sides, curl without swinging, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar over mid-foot, flat back, push the floor away, lock out hips and knees together.

exercises.name: Barbell farmers carry
exercises.cue: Carry a barbell by the centre in one hand, or one in each hand, tall and braced.

exercises.name: Barbell front-rack lunge
exercises.cue: Bar in the front rack, elbows high, step long and touch the back knee, drive up through the front foot.

exercises.name: Barbell front squat
exercises.cue: Bar on front delts, elbows high, upright torso, sit straight down.

exercises.name: Ground-to-overhead
exercises.cue: Floor to lockout overhead any way: snatch, or clean and jerk.

exercises.name: Hang power clean
exercises.cue: From above the knee, extend the hips hard and catch the bar on the shoulders in a quarter squat.

exercises.name: Hang power snatch
exercises.cue: From above the knee, wide grip, extend and punch the bar overhead, catching above parallel.

exercises.name: Barbell hang squat clean
exercises.cue: From above the knee, pull under into a full front squat.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on bench, bar over hips, drive hips up to a straight line, chin tucked.

exercises.name: Barbell incline bench press
exercises.cue: Bench ~30°, bar to upper chest, elbows tucked, press to lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell lunge
exercises.cue: Long step, back knee toward the floor, front shin vertical, push back to standing.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
exercises.cue: Bar at collarbone, brace, press straight up, head through at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead walk
exercises.cue: Bar locked out overhead, ribs down, walk with short steps.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead walking lunge
exercises.cue: Bar locked out overhead, long steps, back knee touches, arms stay straight.

exercises.name: Overhead squat
exercises.cue: Bar locked out overhead with a wide grip, squat below parallel keeping the bar over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead walking lunge
exercises.cue: Bar locked out overhead, long steps, back knee kisses the floor, stand tall between steps.

exercises.name: Barbell power clean
exercises.cue: Floor to shoulders, receive above parallel.

exercises.name: Power snatch
exercises.cue: Wide grip, pull from the floor and punch the bar overhead, receiving above parallel.

exercises.name: Barbell push jerk
exercises.cue: Dip, drive, and drop under the bar into a partial squat, stand to finish.

exercises.name: Push press
exercises.cue: Bar on the shoulders, shallow dip, drive with the legs and press to lockout overhead.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, hinge at the hips, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstrings, stand tall.

exercises.name: Barbell bent-over row
exercises.cue: Hinge to ~45°, flat back, pull bar to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift high pull
exercises.cue: Wide stance, narrow grip, stand fast and pull the bar to the chin, elbows high.

exercises.name: Shoulder to overhead
exercises.cue: Bar from the shoulders to lockout overhead any way: strict press, push press or jerk.

exercises.name: Skullcrusher (lying triceps extension)
exercises.cue: Lying on a bench, bar or EZ bar over the face, lower to the forehead by bending only the elbows, extend.

exercises.name: Snatch
exercises.cue: Wide grip, bar from floor to overhead in one movement; squat or power, lock it out and stand.

exercises.name: Squat clean
exercises.cue: Pull, then drop under and receive the bar in a full front squat, stand it up.

exercises.name: Squat clean thruster
exercises.cue: Clean from the floor into a full squat and drive straight into a thruster.

exercises.name: Barbell step-up
exercises.cue: Bar on the back, whole foot on the box, drive through the front leg.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
exercises.cue: Wide stance, toes out, hands inside the knees; push the knees out and the floor away, hips through at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell thruster
exercises.cue: Front squat straight into a push press, one movement; bar finishes locked out overhead.

exercises.name: Ankle stretch
exercises.cue: Leg straight and raised, point the toes away then back towards you.

exercises.name: Arch hang
exercises.cue: Hang from the bar, pull the shoulder blades down and back, chest up into an arch, hold or repeat.

exercises.name: Arm circles
exercises.cue: Arms straight out to the sides, small to large circles, forward then back.

exercises.name: Standing arm open and close
exercises.cue: Arms extended at shoulder height, open wide and squeeze closed in front, keep the shoulders down.

exercises.name: Back raise
exercises.cue: Lying face down, hands by the temples, raise the shoulders no more than 7.5 cm off the floor, long neck, look down.

exercises.name: Burpee over the bar
exercises.cue: Burpee facing the bar, chest to the floor, then jump over the bar with two feet and turn around.

exercises.name: Bar muscle-up
exercises.cue: Pull high, roll over the bar, press to support.

exercises.name: Bear crawl
exercises.cue: Hands and feet on the floor, knees just off the ground, crawl forward.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.cue: Hands gripping the edge of a chair or the floor behind you, hips lifted, bend the elbows to about 90 degrees and push back up.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
exercises.cue: On the back, hands behind the head, bring opposite elbow to knee as the other leg extends.

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.cue: Swing the arms, jump, land softly on the whole foot, step down.

exercises.name: Box jump-over
exercises.cue: Jump onto or over the box and land on the far side; no need to stand tall on top.

exercises.name: Box step-up
exercises.cue: Whole foot on the box, stand tall on top, step down and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Standing broad jump
exercises.cue: Two-foot take-off and landing, swing the arms, jump as far as you can each rep.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.cue: Drop to the floor, chest down, jump the feet in, jump up.

exercises.name: Burpee box jump
exercises.cue: Burpee, then jump onto the box.

exercises.name: Burpee box jump over
exercises.cue: Burpee, jump onto and over the box.

exercises.name: Burpee broad jump
exercises.cue: Chest to the floor, stand and broad-jump forward with two feet, straight into the next burpee. Count metres.

exercises.name: Burpee muscle-up
exercises.cue: Burpee, then jump to the rings or bar and do a muscle-up.

exercises.name: Lateral burpee over dumbbell
exercises.cue: Chest to the floor beside the dumbbell, jump up and sideways over it with two feet.

exercises.name: Burpee pull-up
exercises.cue: Burpee, then jump to the bar and do a pull-up.

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.cue: Jog on the spot, heels flick up to the glutes.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.cue: Hands on a wall or chair, rise slowly onto the toes and lower the heels under control.

exercises.name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
exercises.cue: Pull until the chest touches the bar below the collarbone, full lockout at the bottom.

exercises.name: Bottom to heels stretch
exercises.cue: On all fours, move the bottom back towards the heels and hold for a breath, back and neck straight.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.cue: Underhand grip, chin over the bar, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Back extension on forearms
exercises.cue: Lie on the front propped on the forearms, push down on the hands to arch the back gently, hips stay on the floor.

exercises.name: Cool-down and stretch (follow the video)
exercises.cue: General cool-down segment; follow the instructor's stretches.

exercises.name: Corkscrew
exercises.cue: On the back, legs together lifted, rotate the legs in a circle or side to side using the obliques.

exercises.name: Cossack squat
exercises.cue: Wide stance, sit fully into one leg with the other straight and toes up, shift across.

exercises.name: Crab toe touch
exercises.cue: Reverse tabletop on hands and feet, kick one leg up and touch the toe with the opposite hand.

exercises.name: Cross-body mountain climber
exercises.cue: High plank, drive each knee under the body to the opposite elbow, fast.

exercises.name: Cross-body toe touch
exercises.cue: Standing, kick or raise one leg and touch it with the opposite hand.

exercises.name: Cross jacks
exercises.cue: Jumping jack where feet and arms cross in front instead of landing wide.

exercises.name: Stomach crunch
exercises.cue: Knees bent, hands behind the ears, lower back pressed into the floor, lift the shoulder blades no more than 7.5 cm and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Curtsy lunge
exercises.cue: Step one leg behind and across the other, lower until the back knee nearly touches, stand.

exercises.name: Dance cardio
exercises.cue: Follow the on-screen choreography for the whole song; keep moving, big arms, land soft.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: On the back, arms up and knees over hips, extend opposite arm and leg, keep the lower back down.

exercises.name: Bar hang
exercises.cue: Hang from the pull-up bar with straight arms; grip is the whole exercise.

exercises.name: Deadbug
exercises.cue: On the back, arms up and knees over hips; lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed into the floor.

exercises.name: Deep abdominal brace
exercises.cue: Lying on the back, knees bent, breathe out and gently draw the lower tummy and pelvic floor up towards the chest; hold and breathe.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.cue: Lean slightly forward, lower until upper arms are parallel, press up.

exercises.name: One-leg kickback
exercises.cue: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent at 90 degrees and raise the leg behind you, squeezing the glute.

exercises.name: Double-unders
exercises.cue: Rope passes twice under the feet per jump; jump a little higher, spin from the wrists.

exercises.name: Fast feet
exercises.cue: Quarter squat, feet chop the floor as fast as possible.

exercises.name: Fire and movement
exercises.cue: Short tactical bounds: up, sprint, down into cover, repeat; finish with a crawl and a sprint.

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.cue: On the back, legs straight, small alternating kicks; 4 kicks = 1 rep.

exercises.name: Forward roll
exercises.cue: Tuck the chin, roll over the upper back and stand up without using the hands.

exercises.name: Front kicks
exercises.cue: Standing, kick one leg forward to hip height, alternate sides.

exercises.name: Grapevine
exercises.cue: Walk sideways crossing one foot over the other; smaller steps work the balance harder, fingers on a wall if needed.

exercises.name: Hand-release push-up
exercises.cue: Chest to the floor, lift the hands, press back up.

exercises.name: Handstand
exercises.cue: Kick up into a handstand, hold briefly, come down under control.

exercises.name: Handstand push-up
exercises.cue: Kick up against the wall, lower the head to the floor, press back to lockout. Kipping is fine.

exercises.name: Handstand walk
exercises.cue: Kick up, stack the hips over the hands and walk forward in short steps; each 5 ft segment counts.

exercises.name: Hanging hip touch
exercises.cue: Hang from the bar, swing the legs up and touch one hip to the bar, alternate sides.

exercises.name: Heel digs
exercises.cue: Alternate heels to the front, toes up, punch out with each dig, soft knee on the standing leg.

exercises.name: Heel-to-toe walk
exercises.cue: Place the heel of one foot directly in front of the toes of the other, look forward, fingers on a wall if needed.

exercises.name: Heel touches
exercises.cue: On the back, knees bent, crunch sideways to tap each heel with the same-side hand.

exercises.name: Heisman
exercises.cue: Shuffle sideways two steps and lift the outside knee, holding the pose like the trophy.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.cue: Run on the spot driving each knee to hip height, quick feet, arms pumping.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Feet flat, drive hips to the ceiling, squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Seated hip marching
exercises.cue: Sit upright away from the back of the chair, lift one knee as far as comfortable, place the foot down with control, alternate.

exercises.name: Hollow hold (ab hold)
exercises.cue: On the back, lower back pressed down, shoulders and legs hovering, hold.

exercises.name: The hundred
exercises.cue: Head and shoulders lifted, legs in tabletop or extended, pump the arms while breathing in fives.

exercises.name: In-and-outs (seated knee tucks)
exercises.cue: Seated with hands beside the hips, extend the legs out then tuck the knees in.

exercises.name: In-and-out squat (squat jack / pop squat)
exercises.cue: Jump the feet wide into a squat, then jump back together; hands touch the floor on pop squats.

exercises.name: Inchworm (walk-out)
exercises.cue: Fold and walk the hands out to a plank, then walk them back to the feet and stand.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.cue: Hang under a bar or rings, body straight, pull the chest to the bar and lower under control. Lower the bar or raise the feet to make it harder.

exercises.name: Jackknife (V-up)
exercises.cue: Lie flat, lift arms and legs together to touch the toes above the hips, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Jog on the spot
exercises.cue: Light run in place, easy pace, used for warm-ups and active rest.

exercises.name: Jumping lunges
exercises.cue: Lunge, jump and switch legs in the air, land soft in the opposite lunge.

exercises.name: Jump squat
exercises.cue: Squat, explode up, land softly back into the squat.

exercises.name: Twist jumps
exercises.cue: Small jump, rotate hips one way and shoulders the other, feet together.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.cue: Arms overhead as the feet go wide, snap back together.

exercises.name: Jumping pull-up
exercises.cue: Bar about a forearm above the head, jump and pull the chin over the bar, lower to straight arms.

exercises.name: Knee drives
exercises.cue: From a split stance, drive the back knee up to the chest fast, reset and repeat.

exercises.name: Knee lifts
exercises.cue: Stand tall, bring alternate knees up to touch the opposite hand, abs tight.

exercises.name: Three-quarter press-up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, knees on the floor, lower the chest to about 5 cm off the floor and push back up.

exercises.name: Knee rolls
exercises.cue: On the back, knees bent and together, roll the knees to one side keeping both shoulders down.

exercises.name: Kneel to stand
exercises.cue: From kneeling, step one foot forward and stand without using the hands, kneel back down.

exercises.name: Knees-to-elbows
exercises.cue: Hang, bring the knees up to touch the elbows.

exercises.name: L pull-up
exercises.cue: Legs held straight out in front, pull chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Lateral hops (line jumps)
exercises.cue: Feet together, hop side to side over a line or object.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge (side lunge)
exercises.cue: Step wide to one side, sit into that hip with the other leg straight, push back to standing.

exercises.name: Lateral shuffle
exercises.cue: Low athletic stance, shuffle a few steps left then right without crossing the feet.

exercises.name: Standing leg circles
exercises.cue: Balance on one leg, draw circles with the other knee to open the hip.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.cue: Hang, raise straight legs to parallel or higher, no swinging.

exercises.name: Leg swings
exercises.cue: Hold something for balance, swing one leg forward and back or across the body.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cue: Step long, back knee toward the floor, alternate legs.

exercises.name: March on the spot
exercises.cue: Lift the knees, pump the arms in rhythm, elbows bent, fists soft.

exercises.name: Mini squat
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width, bend the knees only a little (about 10 cm), back straight, come up and squeeze the glutes.

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, drive knees to chest alternately, hips level.

exercises.name: Neck rotation
exercises.cue: Sit upright, shoulders down, turn the head slowly towards one shoulder as far as comfortable.

exercises.name: Neck stretch
exercises.cue: Hold one shoulder down with the opposite hand and tilt the head away from it.

exercises.name: Nordic curl
exercises.cue: Kneel with the ankles anchored, lower the body forward with straight hips as slowly as possible, pull back up (use a band or a push off the floor to assist).

exercises.name: Oblique crunch
exercises.cue: Knees rolled to one side (or one hand behind the ear), curl the upper body diagonally across towards the opposite knee.

exercises.name: One-leg stand
exercises.cue: Face a wall with fingertips touching it, lift one leg keeping the hips level and a slight bend in the standing leg.

exercises.name: Overhead reach
exercises.cue: Reach both arms up and slightly back, alternate or together, to warm the shoulders.

exercises.name: Pelvic tilt
exercises.cue: Flatten the lower back into the floor, tense the stomach, then tilt the pelvis towards the heels; rock slowly.

exercises.name: Pistol (single-leg squat)
exercises.cue: One leg out in front, squat all the way down on the other, stand without touching down. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Forearms down, body in a straight line, squeeze glutes, breathe.

exercises.name: Plank with arm lift
exercises.cue: High plank, lift one arm straight out in front without the hips turning, put it down, switch.

exercises.name: Plank bunny hops
exercises.cue: High plank, hop both feet together side to side or forward and back.

exercises.name: Plank hip dips
exercises.cue: Forearm plank, rotate the hips to tap one side to the floor, then the other.

exercises.name: Plank jacks
exercises.cue: High plank, jump the feet wide and back together, hips level.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder taps
exercises.cue: High plank, tap the opposite shoulder with one hand, keep the hips still.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.cue: Dead hang, pull chest to the bar, control the way down.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line, chest to the floor, elbows ~45°.

exercises.name: Push-up and rotation
exercises.cue: Push-up, then at the top rotate into a side plank with one arm reaching to the ceiling; alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.cue: Knees bent at 90 degrees, pull the knees to the chest until the tailbone lifts off the floor, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse hyperextension
exercises.cue: Hips on the edge of a bench or box, upper body supported, lift straight legs up to horizontal with the glutes and lower back, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Step back into a lunge, front shin vertical, drive up through the front heel.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge, elbow to instep with rotation
exercises.cue: Step back into a lunge, put the opposite hand on the floor, bring the other elbow to the inside of the front foot, then rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling. Stand and alternate.

exercises.name: Reverse plank
exercises.cue: Sit with legs long, hands behind, lift the hips until the body is a straight line.

exercises.name: Russian twist
exercises.cue: Seated, lean back, feet up or down, rotate the torso side to side.

exercises.name: Seated crunch (V-sit crunch)
exercises.cue: Seated with feet off the floor, lean back and crunch up, add a twist for obliques.

exercises.name: Seated thigh contraction
exercises.cue: Sit upright, straighten and raise one leg, squeeze the thigh muscle and hold.

exercises.name: Seated upper-body twist
exercises.cue: Sit upright, arms crossed on the shoulders, turn the upper body as far as comfortable without moving the hips.

exercises.name: Shadow boxing punches
exercises.cue: Boxer stance, alternate straight punches or hooks, rotate the torso with each punch.

exercises.name: Shoulder rolls
exercises.cue: Keep marching, roll the shoulders forwards then backwards, arms loose.

exercises.name: Side-lying leg raise
exercises.cue: Lie on one side, bottom knee bent, raise the top leg without letting the hips tilt back.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cue: Elbow under shoulder, hips high, straight line head to feet.

exercises.name: Standing side reach
exercises.cue: Reach one arm overhead and bend to the opposite side, alternate.

exercises.name: Sideways walking
exercises.cue: Feet together, knees soft, step one foot to the side and bring the other to join it; do not drop the hips.

exercises.name: Sit to stand
exercises.cue: Sit on the edge of a chair, feet hip-width, lean forward, stand up with the legs (not the arms), sit back down slowly.

exercises.name: Sit-up
exercises.cue: Feet flat, curl up through the spine, lower with control.

exercises.name: Skater jumps
exercises.cue: Leap sideways from one foot to the other, trailing leg sweeps behind, land soft.

exercises.name: Spider-Man plank
exercises.cue: High plank, bring one knee out to the same-side elbow, alternate.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width, sit back and down, chest up, drive through the heels.

exercises.name: Standing crunch (elbow to knee)
exercises.cue: Hands behind the head, lift a knee and bring the opposite elbow to it.

exercises.name: Standing leg extension
exercises.cue: Hands on a chair, raise one straight leg backwards without arching the back, feel the hamstring and glute.

exercises.name: Standing sideways leg lift
exercises.cue: Hands on a chair, raise one leg out to the side keeping the back and hips straight, no tilting.

exercises.name: Star jumps
exercises.cue: Jump up spreading arms and legs into a star, land softly with knees together and hands by the sides.

exercises.name: Starfish crunch
exercises.cue: Lie in a star shape, crunch up bringing one hand to the opposite foot, alternate.

exercises.name: Step jack
exercises.cue: Low-impact jumping jack: step one foot out at a time while the arms go overhead.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.cue: Step up with one foot, bring the other up to join it, step down slowly and in control.

exercises.name: Buttock stretch
exercises.cue: On the back, cross one ankle over the opposite thigh, pull the lower thigh towards the chest.

exercises.name: Calf stretch
exercises.cue: Step one leg back straight with the heel down, front knee bent, hands on a wall, push the back heel into the floor.

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.cue: Shoulders back and down, arms out or hands on hips, push the chest forward and up.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.cue: Sit into the lowest squat you can with heels down, elbows push the knees out.

exercises.name: Standing forward bend
exercises.cue: Feet hip-width, hinge from the waist bringing the chest towards the thighs, legs and back straight.

exercises.name: Lying hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: On the back, hold one straight leg below the knee and pull it towards you, other foot on the floor.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: Sit tall with straight legs, bend from the hips and bring the chest towards the thighs, back straight.

exercises.name: Standing hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: One leg forward on the heel with toes up (or on a step), bend the other knee, hinge forward with a straight back.

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Step forward, keep the back leg straight, bend the front knee and push the back hip forward.

exercises.name: Inner thigh stretch
exercises.cue: Sit tall with the soles of the feet together, hold the feet and lower the knees towards the floor.

exercises.name: ITB stretch
exercises.cue: Cross one leg behind the other, lean away from it and push the hip outwards, feet flat, no bending forward.

exercises.name: Knee to chest stretch
exercises.cue: On the back, pull one or both knees to the chest with the hands, head down, neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Overhead stretch
exercises.cue: Extend the arms over the head and lengthen from toes to fingertips, breathing slowly.

exercises.name: Sciatic mobilising stretch
exercises.cue: On the back, knee to chest, hold behind the thigh and slowly straighten the knee, then bend and return.

exercises.name: Side stretch
exercises.cue: Reach one arm overhead and lean to the opposite side, or slide one hand down the side of the leg; feel the opposite hip or side.

exercises.name: Thigh stretch
exercises.cue: Hold the top of the foot and pull the heel towards the buttock, knees together, hips forward, hold a wall for balance.

exercises.name: Upper back stretch
exercises.cue: Clasp the hands, extend the arms forward at shoulder height, look down and round the upper back.

exercises.name: Strict pull-up
exercises.cue: Dead hang, no kip, pull the chin over the bar and lower under control.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.cue: Lie face down, lift arms and legs together, squeeze the back and glutes.

exercises.name: Support hold (parallel bars)
exercises.cue: Lock the arms out on parallel bars or rings, shoulders pushed down away from the ears, hold.

exercises.name: T rotation
exercises.cue: From a push-up position rotate to a side plank reaching the top arm to the ceiling, return, alternate.

exercises.name: Tap backs
exercises.cue: Step one leg back and swing both arms forward, alternate legs in a continuous rhythm; jump the switch for spotty dogs.

exercises.name: Alternating toe taps
exercises.cue: Quick alternating taps of the toes to a spot or step in front of you.

exercises.name: Toe touch crunch
exercises.cue: On the back with legs straight up, crunch and reach the hands to the toes.

exercises.name: Toes-to-bar
exercises.cue: Hang, swing and bring both feet to touch the bar.

exercises.name: Trunk rotation
exercises.cue: Feet parallel, shoulders back and down, rotate the upper body to one side without moving the hips.

exercises.name: Up-and-overs
exercises.cue: Step or hop sideways over an imaginary line, swinging the arms up and across.

exercises.name: Up-down plank
exercises.cue: From a forearm plank push up one arm at a time to a high plank, lower back down, alternate the lead arm.

exercises.name: Wall climb
exercises.cue: Feet on the wall, walk the hands back until the chest touches the wall, then walk back out.

exercises.name: Wall press-up
exercises.cue: Arm's length from the wall, hands at chest height, elbows tucked, bend the arms to bring the chest to the wall and push back.

exercises.name: Wall squat
exercises.cue: Back against the wall, feet a foot out, slide down by bending the knees, knees behind the toes, tense the thighs on the way up.

exercises.name: Wall walk
exercises.cue: From chest on the floor, walk the feet up the wall and the hands in until they touch the line, then walk back out to the start.

exercises.name: Warm-up (follow the video)
exercises.cue: General warm-up segment; follow the instructor's moves.

exercises.name: Weighted pull-up
exercises.cue: Dumbbell between the feet or belt, dead hang to chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Band shoulder dislocates
exercises.cue: Wide grip on a band or stick, arms straight, take it over the head and behind, then back to the front.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Rope at face height, pull toward the eyes, elbows high, squeeze the rear delts.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Lean back slightly, pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Cable or band at chest height from the side, press the hands straight out and hold against the twist, bring back. Both sides.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Chest up, pull the handle to the stomach, squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Tricep pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned, push down to lockout, control the way up.

exercises.name: Assault bike
exercises.cue: Push and pull with the arms, drive with the legs, keep the cadence up.

exercises.name: Stationary bike
exercises.cue: Seat at hip height, smooth cadence, hands light on the bars.

exercises.name: Cross trainer
exercises.cue: Push through the heels, use the handles, keep an upright posture.

exercises.name: Skipping
exercises.cue: Light on the toes, wrists turn the rope, small jumps.

exercises.name: Rowing machine
exercises.cue: Legs, then body, then arms on the drive; arms, body, legs on the way back.

exercises.name: Run
exercises.cue: Relaxed shoulders, quick light steps, land under the hips.

exercises.name: Shuttle run
exercises.cue: Sprint out to the mark, touch and sprint back; one rep is out and back.

exercises.name: Ski erg
exercises.cue: Reach high, drive the handles down with the hips and arms together.

exercises.name: Stair climber
exercises.cue: Whole foot on each step, hands light, stand tall.

exercises.name: Swim
exercises.cue: Long strokes, steady breathing, count lengths.

exercises.name: Walk
exercises.cue: Brisk but comfortable, arms swinging, look ahead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Dumbbells at chest level, press up and in, control the descent.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Rear foot on a bench, drop straight down, front knee over toes, push through the heel.

exercises.name: Dumbbell burpee deadlift
exercises.cue: Burpee with hands on the dumbbells, stand up into a deadlift.

exercises.name: Dumbbell chest fly
exercises.cue: Flat bench, slight elbow bend, open the arms wide to a chest stretch, squeeze back up in an arc.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows at the sides, curl with control, no swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell deadlift
exercises.cue: Dumbbells outside the feet, flat back, stand tall.

exercises.name: Dumbbell farmers carry
exercises.cue: One dumbbell in each hand, tall posture, quick steps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.cue: Lying on the floor, elbows touch down each rep, press to lockout.

exercises.name: Front raise
exercises.cue: Slight elbow bend, raise to shoulder height, lower under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front squat
exercises.cue: Dumbbells on the shoulders, elbows forward, squat below parallel and stand.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold the weight at the chest, elbows inside the knees at the bottom, chest up.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.cue: Neutral grip, palms facing in, curl to the shoulder, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hang clean and jerk
exercises.cue: From the hang, clean two dumbbells to the shoulders, then dip and drive them overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hang split snatch
exercises.cue: From the hang, snatch overhead while splitting the feet, alternate feet.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hang squat clean
exercises.cue: Dumbbells at the hang, pull under into a full squat, stand.

exercises.name: Incline chest press
exercises.cue: Bench at ~30°. Elbows ~45° from torso, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral lunge
exercises.cue: Step wide, sit into one hip with dumbbells at the sides or chest, push back.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge to overhead triceps extension
exercises.cue: Step wide to the side into a lunge holding one dumbbell at the chest, push back to standing and extend it overhead behind the head. Alternate sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lunge
exercises.cue: Dumbbells at the sides, long step, front shin vertical, drive back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead walking lunge
exercises.cue: One dumbbell locked out overhead, alternate legs, back knee to the floor, hips open at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell power clean
exercises.cue: Both dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders without a full squat; stand fully before dropping.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.cue: Lying, dumbbell(s) over the chest, lower behind the head with soft elbows and pull back over.

exercises.name: Dumbbell push press
exercises.cue: Dip the knees and drive the dumbbells overhead using the legs, lower under control.

exercises.name: Push-up to row to burpee
exercises.cue: Hands on dumbbells, push-up, row each dumbbell to the ribs, jump the feet in and jump up. Light weights.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hinge at the hips with soft knees, dumbbells slide down the thighs, stand tall.

exercises.name: Rear delt fly
exercises.cue: Hinge forward, arms out to the sides leading with the elbows, squeeze the upper back.

exercises.name: Renegade row
exercises.cue: High plank on the dumbbells, row one to the hip without twisting the hips, alternate.

exercises.name: Dumbbell row
exercises.cue: One hand on the bench, flat back, pull the dumbbell to the hip, elbow close.

exercises.name: Shoulder press
exercises.cue: Standing, dumbbells at shoulders, press overhead. Ribs down, no arching.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift to curl to press
exercises.cue: Balance on one leg, hinge until the dumbbells reach shin height, stand, curl, press overhead. Same leg for the whole interval.

exercises.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
exercises.cue: Lying, dumbbells over the chest, bend the elbows to lower beside the head, extend.

exercises.name: Dumbbell snatch
exercises.cue: One dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one pull, lock out, switch hands each rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split clean
exercises.cue: Clean two dumbbells to the shoulders while landing in a split stance; alternate the lead leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front squat
exercises.cue: Dumbbells on the shoulders, squat below parallel, drive up to full extension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell squat clean
exercises.cue: Dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders, receive in a full squat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell squat clean thruster
exercises.cue: Clean two dumbbells into a full squat and drive straight into a press overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
exercises.cue: Whole foot on the box, drive through the front leg, no push from the back foot.

exercises.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
exercises.cue: Wide stance, toes out, one dumbbell hanging between the legs, squat and drive the knees out.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell swing
exercises.cue: Hinge and swing one dumbbell between the legs to chest height, hips snap, switch hands halfway.

exercises.name: Dumbbell thruster
exercises.cue: Front squat straight into an overhead press, one fluid movement.

exercises.name: Overhead tricep extension
exercises.cue: One dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower behind the head, elbows pointing forward.

exercises.name: Triceps kickback
exercises.cue: Kneel and lean forward, elbow raised behind you at 90 degrees, straighten the arm back, bend and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell upright row
exercises.cue: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, pull up to chest height leading with the elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell waiters walk
exercises.cue: One dumbbell locked out overhead, walk with the ribs down.

exercises.name: Back extension
exercises.cue: On the GHD, hinge down and extend the back to horizontal.

exercises.name: Ball slam
exercises.cue: Ball overhead, slam it to the floor, pick it up and repeat.

exercises.name: Vehicle casevac lift
exercises.cue: Lift the load from the floor to vehicle-bed height with a flat back, step in close before lifting.

exercises.name: Casualty drag
exercises.cue: Grip the harness or bag, stay low, lean back and drive with the legs walking backward.

exercises.name: Farmers carry
exercises.cue: A kettlebell in each hand, shoulders packed, walk fast with short steps and a tall chest.

exercises.name: GHD sit-up
exercises.cue: On the GHD, extend back and touch the floor, sit up to touch the pads.

exercises.name: Loaded march
exercises.cue: Walk or shuffle at pace with the load in a pack or webbing; steady breathing, keep the stride long.

exercises.name: Medicine-ball box step-over
exercises.cue: Holding the ball, step up onto the box, stand tall and step down the other side.

exercises.name: Medicine-ball clean
exercises.cue: Ball from the floor, extend the hips, pull under into a squat with the ball at the chest and stand.

exercises.name: Muscle-up
exercises.cue: Pull high on rings or bar, transition the chest over the hands, press out to lockout.

exercises.name: Partner carry
exercises.cue: Fireman's carry, piggyback or partner barbell carry over the distance; swap halfway if you like.

exercises.name: Plate carry
exercises.cue: Carry a plate at the chest or overhead for distance.

exercises.name: Plate overhead walking lunge
exercises.cue: Plate locked out overhead, walking lunges.

exercises.name: Repeated lift and carry
exercises.cue: Lift the bag from the floor, carry it the set distance, place it down, return and repeat.

exercises.name: Ring dip
exercises.cue: Support on the rings, lower until the shoulders dip below the elbows, press back to lockout with rings turned out.

exercises.name: Inverted hang lower
exercises.cue: From an inverted hang on the rings, lower slowly with straight body and arms.

exercises.name: Ring push-up
exercises.cue: Push-up with hands on the rings, stabilise, chest to ring height.

exercises.name: Ring row
exercises.cue: Body straight, pull the chest to the rings.

exercises.name: Rope climb
exercises.cue: Climb to the 15-ft mark, wrap the feet, descend under control.

exercises.name: Weighted box step-up
exercises.cue: Ruck, weighted pack or vest on, whole foot on the box, stand tall on top, alternate legs.

exercises.name: Sandbag carry
exercises.cue: Sandbag on the shoulder or in the arms, walk or run for distance.

exercises.name: Sandbag walking lunge
exercises.cue: Sandbag across the shoulders behind the neck, alternate legs, back knee touches the floor each step.

exercises.name: Sandbag ground-to-over-shoulder
exercises.cue: Lift the sandbag from the floor and throw it over the shoulder.

exercises.name: Sled pull (arm over arm)
exercises.cue: Sit or brace, pull the rope hand over hand until the sled reaches you.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.cue: Arms straight or bent, lean into the sled and drive with short quick steps.

exercises.name: Sprint-drag-carry
exercises.cue: Five 50 m shuttles on a 25 m lane: sprint, backward sled drag, lateral shuffle, kettlebell carry, sprint. For time.

exercises.name: Standing power throw
exercises.cue: Back to the line, medicine ball in both hands, dip and throw it backward over the head as far as possible. Score = distance.

exercises.name: Wall ball
exercises.cue: Squat with the ball at the chest, drive up and throw to the target, catch and drop straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Water can carry
exercises.cue: A jerry can in each hand, shoulders back, walk fast. Stretcher-carry simulation.

exercises.name: Incline walk
exercises.cue: Hands off the rails. Walk tall, push through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean
exercises.cue: Swing the bell up and rotate it around the wrist into the rack, no banging the forearm.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean and jerk
exercises.cue: Swing the bell into the rack, then dip and drive it overhead to lockout.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.cue: Bell between the feet, hinge, flat back, stand tall.

exercises.name: Double kettlebell front-rack carry
exercises.cue: Two bells in the rack, ribs down, walk tall.

exercises.name: Double kettlebell front-rack lunge
exercises.cue: Two bells in the rack, elbows in, step long and touch the back knee.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squat
exercises.cue: Bell at the chest, elbows inside the knees, chest up, drive through the heels.

exercises.name: Kettlebell walking lunge
exercises.cue: Two bells at the sides or in the rack, long steps, back knee to the floor.

exercises.name: Double kettlebell overhead carry
exercises.cue: Two bells locked out overhead, biceps by the ears, walk without leaning back.

exercises.name: Single-arm kettlebell overhead squat
exercises.cue: Bell locked out overhead in one hand, squat below parallel keeping the bell over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Kettlebell press
exercises.cue: From the rack, press straight up, lock out, lower under control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell row
exercises.cue: Hinge, pull the bell to the hip, elbow close to the body.

exercises.name: Kettlebell snatch
exercises.cue: One swing into a punch-through overhead, bell lands softly on the wrist.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings
exercises.cue: Hinge, not squat. Snap the hips, arms are ropes, bell to chest height.

exercises.name: Kettlebell thruster
exercises.cue: Bells in the rack, squat and drive them overhead in one movement.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.cue: Bell locked out overhead the whole way, roll to elbow, hand, bridge, sweep, stand. Slow.

exercises.name: Lateral raises
exercises.cue: Slight elbow bend, raise to shoulder height, lead with the elbows, control the way down.

exercises.name: Calf press (leg press)
exercises.cue: Feet low on the leg-press plate, legs straight, push through the balls of the feet, full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.cue: Standing on a block or machine, full stretch at the bottom, pause on the toes at the top.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.cue: Handles at chest height, press to lockout, control the return.

exercises.name: Leg curl
exercises.cue: Curl the pad toward the glutes, pause, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.cue: Extend to straight, squeeze the quads, lower under control.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower until knees ~90°, press without locking hard.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.cue: Knees bent under the pad, drop the heels for a full stretch, rise onto the toes and pause.

exercises.name: Shoulder press machine
exercises.cue: Press overhead, don't lock out hard, lower to ear level.

exercises.name: Treadmill sprints
exercises.cue: Belt keeps running. Hands on rails, hop to the side platforms for the rest, step back on for the next sprint.

exercises.name: Boat pose (Navasana)
exercises.cue: Seated, lean back and lift the shins parallel to the floor (half boat) or straighten the legs.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.cue: From tabletop, inhale to drop the belly and lift the gaze, exhale to round the spine and tuck the chin.

exercises.name: Seated chest opener
exercises.cue: Fingertips behind you on the floor, lift the chest and draw the shoulders back.

exercises.name: Child's pose (Balasana)
exercises.cue: Knees wide or together, hips to the heels, forehead down, arms long or by the sides.

exercises.name: Cobra pose
exercises.cue: Lie on the belly, hands under the shoulders, peel the chest up with light hands.

exercises.name: Downward-facing dog
exercises.cue: Hands and feet on the mat, hips high, long spine, heels reaching toward the floor.

exercises.name: Standing forward fold (Uttanasana)
exercises.cue: Feet hip-width, fold from the hips with soft knees, let the head hang.

exercises.name: Low lunge (runner's lunge)
exercises.cue: Front knee over the ankle, back knee down or lifted, hips sink forward.

exercises.name: Mountain pose (Tadasana)
exercises.cue: Stand tall, feet grounded, shoulders relaxed, breathe.

exercises.name: Puppy pose (Anahatasana)
exercises.cue: From tabletop walk the hands forward, hips stay over the knees, chest melts toward the floor.

exercises.name: Savasana (corpse pose)
exercises.cue: Lie flat on the back, arms by the sides, palms up, relax completely.

exercises.name: Seated twist
exercises.cue: Seated, inhale to lengthen, exhale to rotate, one hand behind you and one on the knee.

exercises.name: Shark fin
exercises.cue: Sit on the heels or kneel, one arm bends so the hand is behind the head like a fin, lean and breathe, switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated side body stretch
exercises.cue: One hand down, the other reaches up and over to open the side body, then switch.

exercises.name: Sphinx pose
exercises.cue: Lie on the belly, forearms down with elbows under the shoulders, lift the chest.

exercises.name: Easy pose (Sukhasana)
exercises.cue: Sit cross-legged, spine tall, hands on the knees or at the heart; breathe.

exercises.name: Tabletop
exercises.cue: On hands and knees, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips, neutral spine.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
exercises.cue: From tabletop slide one arm under the body, shoulder and ear to the mat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Upward salute / volcano pose
exercises.cue: From mountain, reach both arms up overhead, lift through the chest.

exercises.name: Warrior I
exercises.cue: Long stance, back foot turned in, front knee bent, arms reach overhead.

exercises.name: Warrior II
exercises.cue: Wide stance, front knee bent over the ankle, arms out in a line, gaze over the front hand.

exercises.name: Wrist circles
exercises.cue: From tabletop, roll the wrists and shake out the hands.
